items.example: I get on with my sister really well.
items.simple: You and another person like each other and have fun together.

items.example: We fell out over something silly.
items.simple: Two friends are cross with each other and stop being friends.

items.example: They had a fight, but they made up.
items.simple: After a fight, you say sorry and are friends again.
items.note: "make up" aynı zamanda makyaj yapmak anlamına da gelir.

items.example: You can count on me.
items.simple: You know the person will help you when you need it.

items.example: I trust her completely.
items.simple: You believe someone is good and will not lie to you.

items.example: We had a silly argument.
items.simple: When two people say cross words to each other.

items.example: Me and Tom? We go way back.
items.exampleTr: Tom ve ben mi? Eskiden beri tanışırız.
items.simple: You have known each other for a very long time.

items.example: Don't worry, I'm on your side.
items.simple: You help this person, and you are not against them.

items.example: Let's keep in touch after the holiday.
items.simple: Let us talk again, so we do not forget each other.

items.example: We still keep in touch.
items.simple: You send messages or call each other, so you stay friends.

items.example: We have a lot in common.
items.simple: You like the same things as the other person.

items.example: I look up to my big brother.
items.simple: You think someone is great and want to be like them.

items.example: I don't want to let you down.
items.simple: You said you would help, but you did not. Now they feel sad.

items.example: We grew apart after school.
items.simple: Slowly you stop being close, because you are not together much.

items.example: He asked her out for dinner.
items.simple: You ask a person to go somewhere nice, with only the two of you.

items.example: I've known Ali for ten years.
items.simple: You met them a long time ago, and you still know them.

items.en: Sorry I'm late. It's my fault.
items.example: Sorry, it's my fault. I forgot.
items.simple: You say you did the bad thing, and you feel sorry.

items.tr: Sana bir borcum var, sağ ol.
items.example: Thanks for helping. I owe you one!
items.exampleTr: Yardım ettiğin için sağ ol. Sana bir borcum var!
items.simple: You say thanks, and you will help them next time.

items.example: Mind your own business, please.
items.simple: Do not look into things that are not yours.
items.note: Biraz sert; arkadaşlar arasında dikkatli kullan.

items.example: She bumped into her ex.
items.simple: A person you used to love, but now you do not.

items.example: They split up last year.
items.simple: Two people stop being together.

items.example: You can talk to me, you know.
items.simple: You say it is okay to tell me anything.

items.example: I'm getting to know my new neighbours.
items.simple: You learn about a person little by little.
